     *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
     *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
     *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
     */
    public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
        this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
        this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
        this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
        this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
        this.map = new HashMap<>();
    }

    private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
        this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
        this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
        this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
        this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
        this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
    }

     *
     * @return maximum height.

    public int getMaxHeight() {
        return map.keySet().stream()
                .mapToInt(Position::y)
                .max()
                .orElse(-1) + 1;

    public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
        if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
        }
        String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
        if (lines.length < 2) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
        }
        int undoLimit;
        try {
            undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
        }
        if (undoLimit < -1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
        }
        Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
        Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
        Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
        int height = lines.length - 1;
        int width = 0;
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            String line = lines[y + 1];
            if (line.length() > width) {
                width = line.length();
            }
            for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(x);
                Position pos = new Position(x, y);
                Entity entity;
                if (ch == '#') {
                    entity = new Wall();
                } else if (ch == '@') {
                    entity = new Empty();
                    destinations.add(pos);
                } else if (ch == '.') {
                    entity = new Empty();
                } else if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                    if (players.containsKey(ch)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player id: " + ch);
                    }
                    int playerId = ch - 'A';
                    if (playerId < 0 || playerId >= 26) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player id must be A-Z");
                    }
                    entity = new Player(playerId);
                    players.put(ch, pos);
                } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                    int playerId = ch - 'a';
                    if (playerId < 0 || playerId >= 26) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box player id must be a-z");
                    }
                    entity = new Box(playerId);
                    boxes.computeIfAbsent(ch, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
                } else {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
                }
                map.put(pos, entity);
            }
            for (int x = line.length(); x < width; x++) {
                Position pos = new Position(x, y);
                map.put(pos, new Empty());
            }
        }
        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player in the map");
        }
        int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
        if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
                    + ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
        }
        Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
        Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
        for (int boxPlayerId : boxPlayerIds) {
            if (!playerIds.contains(boxPlayerId)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Box player id '" + (char) (boxPlayerId + 'a') + "' has no matching player");
            }
        }
        for (int playerId : playerIds) {
            if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(playerId)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player id '" + (char) (playerId + 'A') + "' has no matching boxes");
            }
        }
        return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);

					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}

The method `getPlayerPositionById` should iterate over the `entities` map, check if the entity at each position is a `Player`, and if so, compare its id with the given id. If a match is found, return the position. If no player with the given id is found, return `null`.

Here is the complete method implementation:

```java
/**
 * Get the current position of the player with the given id.
 *
 * @param id player id.
 * @return the current position of the player, or null if not found.
 */
public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
        Entity entity = entry.getValue();
        if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
            return entry.getKey();
        }
    }
    return null;
}
```

This uses Java 19's pattern matching for instanceof to simplify the type check and cast.

import assignment.entities.Entity;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Get the undo quota currently left, i.e., the maximum number of undo actions that can be performed from now on.
	 * If undo is unlimited,
	 *
	 * @return the undo quota left (using {@link Optional#of(Object)}) if the game has an undo limit;
	 * {@link Optional#empty()} if the game has unlimited undo.
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {

	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not.
	 * The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 *
	 * @return true is the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Move the entity from one position to another.
	 * This method assumes the validity of this move is ensured.
	 * <b>The validity of the move of the entity in one position to another need not to check.</b>
	 *
	 * @param from The current position of the entity to move.
	 * @param to   The position to move the entity to.
	 */
	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Record a checkpoint of the game state, including:
	 * <li>All current positions of entities in the game map.</li>
	 * <li>Current undo quota</li>
	 * <p>
	 * Checkpoint is used in {@link GameState#undo()}.
	 * Every undo actions reverts the game state to the last checkpoint.
	 */
	public void checkpoint() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Revert the game state to the last checkpoint in history.
	 * This method assumes there is still undo quota left, and decreases the undo quota by one.
	 * <p>
	 * If there is no checkpoint recorded, i.e., before moving any box when the game starts,
	 * revert to the initial game state.
	 */
	public void undo() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get the current position of the player with the given id.
	 * @param id  player id.
	 * @return  the current position of the player, or null if not found.
	 */
	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}
}

The `isWin` method should check whether every destination position in the game is currently occupied by a box. Since `destinations` is a set of positions that must be occupied by boxes, and `entities` maps positions to entities, the method should verify that for all positions in `destinations`, the entity at that position is an instance of `Box`.

Here is the complete implementation of the `isWin` method:

```java
/**
 * Check whether the game wins or not.
 * The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
 *
 * @return true if the game wins.
 */
public boolean isWin() {
    return destinations.stream()
            .allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
}
```

This uses a stream to check all destination positions and returns true only if all are occupied by boxes.

The `move` method should update the internal `entities` map by moving the entity from the `from` position to the `to` position, replacing the `from` position with an `Empty` entity. It should also record this move in the current `Transition` object (`currentTransition`) to keep track of the move history for undo functionality.

Here is a correct implementation of the `move` method for the `GameState` class:

```java
public void move(Position from, Position to) {
    // Get the entity at the 'from' position
    Entity entity = entities.get(from);
    if (entity == null) {
        entity = new Empty();
    }

    // Move the entity to the 'to' position
    entities.put(to, entity);

    // Set the 'from' position to Empty
    entities.put(from, new Empty());

    // Record this move in the current transition
    currentTransition.add(from, to);
}
```

This implementation:
- Retrieves the entity at the `from` position.
- Places that entity at the `to` position.
- Sets the `from` position to an `Empty` entity.
- Records the move in the `currentTransition` for history tracking.

This satisfies the requirement that the validity of the move is assumed and does not check for move validity.

The `checkpoint` method should save the current game state so that it can be restored later when `undo()` is called. This means storing a snapshot of the current positions of all entities and the current undo quota in a `Transition` object and pushing it onto the `history` stack. Since `Transition` currently only stores moves, we can store the current transition (which records moves since last checkpoint) and the undo quota as part of the checkpoint.

However, the existing `Transition` class only stores moves, so to fully restore the state, the checkpoint should store the current transition (which records all moves since last checkpoint) and the undo quota at this point. Then reset the current transition to a new empty one for the next moves.

Here is a correct implementation of the `checkpoint` method:

```java
public void checkpoint() {
    // Push the current transition (moves since last checkpoint) onto history stack
    history.push(currentTransition);
    // Reset currentTransition for next moves
    currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

Explanation:
- The `currentTransition` holds all moves since the last checkpoint.
- When checkpointing, we save this transition to `history`.
- Then reset `currentTransition` to start recording new moves.
- The undo quota is a field in `GameState` and does not need to be saved explicitly here because it is not changed by moves, only by undo operations.
- The `undo()` method will use the last transition in `history` to revert moves.

If you want to also save the undo quota at checkpoint, you would need to extend the `Transition` class or store undo quota separately. But based on the current class design, this is the intended way.

Response Text:---
The `undo` method should revert the game state to the last checkpoint stored in the `history` stack by applying the reverse of the last transition. It also decreases the `undoQuota` by one. If there is no checkpoint in the history, it should revert to the initial game state, which can be done by applying the reverse of all transitions in the history or resetting entities to the initial state (here, we assume reverting all transitions in history). After undoing, the last transition should be removed from the history.

Here is a correct implementation of the `undo` method:

```java
public void undo() {
    if (undoQuota <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
    }
    if (history.isEmpty()) {
        // No checkpoint recorded, revert to initial game state by clearing all transitions
        // Since no transitions, entities remain as initial, so do nothing here.
        // Just decrease undoQuota.
        undoQuota--;
        return;
    }
    Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
    Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
    applyTransition(reverseTransition);
    undoQuota--;
}
```

Explanation:
- Check if undoQuota is positive; if not, throw an exception.
- If no history, just decrease undoQuota and do nothing (revert to initial state).
- Otherwise, pop the last transition, reverse it, and apply it to revert the state.
- Decrease undoQuota by one.

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get the current position of the player with the given id.
	 * @param id  player id.
	 * @return  the current position of the player, or null if not found.
	 */
	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota >= 0) {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		} else {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			entity = new Empty();
		}
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			undoQuota--;
			return;
		}
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		undoQuota--;
	}
}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get the current position of the player with the given id.
	 * @param id  player id.
	 * @return  the current position of the player, or null if not found.
	 */
	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota >= 0) {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		} else {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			entity = new Empty();
		}
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			undoQuota--;
			return;
		}
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		undoQuota--;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The error "The constructor GameState(GameMap) is undefined" occurs because the method named `GameState` in your class is not a constructor but a void method (due to the `void` return type missing, it is treated as a method). In Java, constructors have no return type, not even void.

You need to change the method `public void GameState(GameMap map)` to a proper constructor by removing the `void` keyword.

Here is the corrected constructor for the `GameState` class:

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
    this.entities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            this.entities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
}
```

This will fix the compilation errors related to the missing constructor and allow your tests to run successfully.

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get the current position of the player with the given id.
	 * @param id  player id.
	 * @return  the current position of the player, or null if not found.
	 */
	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota >= 0) {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		} else {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			entity = new Empty();
		}
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			undoQuota--;
			return;
		}
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		undoQuota--;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

- BOT: 
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
    this.entities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            this.entities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
}

Response Text:---
The error occurs because the constructor `GameState(GameMap)` is currently declared as a method (with a `void` return type missing, but actually it has the return type of the class name, so it is treated as a method, not a constructor). In Java, constructors must not have a return type, not even `void`. Your code has:

```java
public void GameState(GameMap map) { ... }
```

which is a method named `GameState`, not a constructor. This causes the compiler to report "The constructor GameState(GameMap) is undefined" because no constructor with that signature exists.

**Fix:** Remove the `void` return type so that it becomes a proper constructor.

---

Corrected class snippet with the fixed constructor:

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

    private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

    private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

    private final int boardWidth;

    private final int boardHeight;

    private final Set<Position> destinations;

    private int undoQuota;

    private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

    // ... other methods ...

    /**
     * Constructor for GameState from a GameMap.
     *
     * @param map the game map to initialize from.
     */
    public GameState(GameMap map) {
        this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
        this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
        this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
        this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
        this.entities = new HashMap<>();
        for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
            for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
                Position pos = new Position(x, y);
                Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
                this.entities.put(pos, entity);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the maximum height of the game map.
     * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
     *
     * @return maximum height.
     */
    public int getMapMaxHeight() {
        return this.boardHeight;
    }

    /**
     * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
     *
     * @return maximum width.
     */
    public int getMapMaxWidth() {
        return this.boardWidth;
    }

    // ... rest of the class unchanged ...
}
```

		this.state = gameState;

	 * @param action The action received from the user.
	 * @return The result of the action.

		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * @param playerPosition The position of the player.
	 * @param move           One-step move. We assume every move has only one step.
	 * @return The action result for the move.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private ActionResult processOneStepMove(@NotNull Position playerPosition, @NotNull Move move) {
		final Position nextPlayerPos = move.nextPosition(playerPosition);
		final Entity nextEntity = this.state.getEntity(nextPlayerPos);

		if (nextEntity instanceof Empty) {
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos); // move if next place is empty
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Wall) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit a wall.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Player) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit another player.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Box box) {
			if (box.getPlayerId() != move.getInitiator()) {
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You cannot move other players' boxes.");
			}
			final Position nextBoxPos = move.nextPosition(nextPlayerPos);
			if (!(this.state.getEntity(nextBoxPos) instanceof Empty))
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "Failed to push the box.");
			this.state.move(nextPlayerPos, nextBoxPos);
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos);
			// Game history checkpoint reached if any box is moved.
			this.state.checkpoint();
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}
		throw new ShouldNotReachException();
	}
}

The `processAction` method should handle different types of `Action` subclasses (`Move`, `Undo`, `Exit`, `InvalidInput`) and return an appropriate `ActionResult`. For `Move`, it should find the player position and call `processOneStepMove`. For `Undo`, it should check if undo quota is available and revert the state. For `Exit`, it should mark the exit flag. For `InvalidInput`, it should return a failed result. If the player is not found for a move, it should return a failed result with a proper message.

Here is a complete implementation of the `processAction` method:

```java
/**
 * @param action The action received from the user.
 * @return The result of the action.
 */
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Move move) {
        Position playerPosition = state.findPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPosition == null) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPosition, move);
    }

    if (action instanceof Undo undo) {
        if (state.getUndoQuota() <= 0) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(undo, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);
        }
        state.undo();
        return new ActionResult.Success(undo);
    }

    if (action instanceof Exit exit) {
        isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(exit);
    }

    if (action instanceof InvalidInput invalidInput) {
        return new ActionResult.Failed(invalidInput, invalidInput.getMessage());
    }

    throw new ShouldNotReachException();
}
```

This implementation covers all expected action types and integrates with the existing game state and helper methods.

The `run` method should implement the main game loop for the terminal Sokoban game. It typically involves rendering the game state, reading player input, processing actions, updating the game state, and checking for game termination conditions.

Here is a complete implementation of the `run` method for the `TerminalSokobanGame` class:

```java
@Override
public void run() {
    boolean running = true;
    while (running) {
        renderingEngine.render(gameState);
        Action action = inputEngine.readAction();
        ActionResult result = gameState.performAction(action);
        renderingEngine.renderActionResult(result);

        if (gameState.isGameOver()) {
            renderingEngine.renderGameOver();
            running = false;
        }
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The method runs a loop until the game is over.
- Each iteration renders the current game state.
- It reads an action from the input engine.
- It performs the action on the game state.
- It renders the result of the action.
- If the game is over, it renders a game over message and exits the loop.

This approach assumes that `renderingEngine` and `inputEngine` provide the necessary methods (`render`, `readAction`, `renderActionResult`, `renderGameOver`), and that `gameState` has methods `performAction(Action)` and `isGameOver()`.

package assignment.tui;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import assignment.game.GameState;
import assignment.game.Position;
import assignment.game.RenderingEngine;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}
}

Response Text:---
The method `fetchAction` should parse the user input line and return an appropriate `Action` instance based on the input. According to the imports and constants, the recognized actions are:  
- `Exit` if the input matches the exit command text,  
- `Undo` if the input is "U" or "u",  
- `Move` if the input matches the MOVE_REGEX pattern (WASD keys or vim-like keys),  
- `InvalidInput` if none of the above match.

Here is a complete implementation of the `fetchAction` method that performs these checks and returns the corresponding `Action`:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        char actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase().charAt(0);
        return new Move(actionChar);
    }

    return new InvalidInput(INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
```

This method reads the input, trims it, and then checks against known commands, returning the appropriate `Action` subclass instance. If no known command matches, it returns an `InvalidInput` action with a message.
